task: Review these macOS application preferences setting labels and defaults. Return them unchanged if all three settings are accurately labeled and their defaults correctly stated per the supplied facts.
input:
Autosave: On by default
Font size: 14pt by default
Theme: System (follows macOS appearance) by default

facts.text: The default font size is 14 points.
The default theme is System, which follows the macOS system appearance setting.

forbidden_additions: A wrong default for any of the three settings.
A claim that the System theme does not follow macOS appearance.
preserve: Theme System following macOS appearance by default.
